metadata.author: Jacqueline Harvey
metadata.description: It's time for school camp and Willa is excited. But Tae, her best same-age friend, seems to be keeping a secret . . .  Things aren’t going too smoothly at camp either, so Willa will need to use all the camp survival skills Frank, her best old-age friend, has taught her and to recruit Woof, her best four-legged friend, to help save the trip.  Can Willa turn everyone into happy campers?
